description: Source code for an LCD controller managing a menu system on a 20x4 display, including menu initialization, joystick input handling, and LCD update routines.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Represents a menu item in the LCD menu tree, with properties for parent, children, text, callback, and display line.

classes.name: MenuTree
classes.description: Manages the hierarchical menu structure, current selection, and visible lines on the LCD.

methods.name: appendStr
methods.description: Appends a suffix string to a buffer and returns the new pointer position.

methods.name: showLine
methods.description: Displays a specific line of information on the LCD based on the line type.

methods.name: fillWithSpaces
methods.description: Fills remaining LCD line space with spaces for clean display.

methods.name: updateHD44780lcd
methods.description: Updates the entire LCD display with current menu and sensor data.

methods.name: onJoystick
methods.description: Handles joystick button presses to navigate the menu.

methods.name: initLcdController
methods.description: Initializes the LCD menu system and related data structures.

methods.name: lcdPrintf
methods.description: Formats and prints a string to the LCD buffer.
